description: This file contains utility functions for working with iterator functions in Go 1.23+, including type checks, iteration helpers, and reflection-based yield handling.

methods.name: HasIterators
methods.description: Returns true indicating support for iterators in Go 1.23+.

methods.name: IsIter
methods.description: Checks if a value is a range-able iterator function.

methods.name: IterKVTypes
methods.description: Returns reflection types of key and value yielded by an iterator function.

methods.name: IsSeq2
methods.description: Checks if a function is compatible with the Seq2 iterator pattern.

methods.name: iterateV
methods.description: Iterates over elements produced by an iterator function, applying a yield callback.

methods.name: iterateKV
methods.description: Iterates over key-value pairs produced by an iterator function, applying a yield callback.
